datasets.provenance: primary port-operator current capability, trade and development-strategy sources
datasets.selection_policy: Capture the major east-coast port systems that materially affect VECA freight/economic geography: Brisbane, Botany, Kembla, Newcastle, Melbourne and Geelong. Preserve current throughput/capacity separately from rail/intermodal access and future expansion optionality.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row must resolve to primary port/operator sources and distinguish current capability from planned/optional expansion. This is not a census of every east-coast commercial port or berth.
